$description: Not in Figma — project decisions that differ from or add to the Figma Number collection.

tap-target.$description: Minimum touch area for interactive components: 48 × 48, the same as Figma's size/touch-min (team decision 2026-10-10; it was 32). Invisible — a control smaller than this keeps its drawn size and grows a ::before / ::after; it never adds height or padding to the layout.

illustration.$description: Empty-state illustration slot (Figma L3 → Empty state, 120×120). No Number variable exists for it.
